DISCUSSION
Each AND gate has two or more inputs and a single output.

The function of an AND gate is to determine when certain conditions are both TRUE at the same time. A HIGH out is only available when all the inputs are HIGH or TRUE.
This circuit demonstrates the function of an AND gate......

When a LOW is applied to the other input, the signal is NOT gated through to the output.
When a HIGH is applied to the other input, the signal IS gated through to the output.
